question: What should the right hand do upon the left, and which fingers where?
premises: of the right hand, should do upon the left, the little finger
by forefinger-thumb union, below right, the left fingers
inference: Right hand works left little finger; forefinger-thumb union arrays left fingers below right.
plain_english: Of the right hand, should do — upon the left, the little finger; by forefinger-thumb union, below right, left fingers.
